summary: Executed both backend and frontend regression for new /print DocumentPrint flow on preview URL. Core print workflows passed (document types, edit/totals, add/remove items, PDF download, WhatsApp behaviors, and /api/documents/generate=200), with one backend security mismatch detected on CORS header behavior.

critical.issue: Credentialed auth response returned Access-Control-Allow-Origin='*' in preview request with Origin header. This violates explicit-origin requirement for credentialed auth responses.

integration_issues.issue: Console showed 2x 401 resource errors before session establishment. DocumentPrint/pdfGenerator-specific runtime errors were not observed.

action_items: Investigate wildcard ACAO ('*') returned on credentialed auth response path in preview ingress/backend chain.
Keep monitoring bootstrap 401 console noise; not blocking print flow but still visible in runtime logs.
critical_code_review_comments: DocumentPrint and pdfGenerator are integration-ready for requested scope; all critical interactions are wired with stable data-testid selectors and passed E2E.
Security/CORS behavior appears inconsistent with backend explicit-origin middleware expectation; likely ingress/header layer override or response-path mismatch.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Used credentials from /app/memory/test_credentials.md (مدير / 123123). Verified /print?type=invoice with vehicleId works, document-sheet/electronic seal present, type switching invoice/diagnosis/quote/receipt works, totals recalc and remaining update correctly, add/remove item works, PDF downloads, WhatsApp shows missing-phone message then opens wa.me after PDF when phone exists, and /api/documents/generate returns 200 for all 4 doc types. Remaining backend failure: auth login CORS explicit-origin test returned '*' in response header.
rca of the issue: RCA: test_documents_generate path is healthy; failure is isolated to CORS credentialed response behavior in auth path. Reproduction: POST /api/auth/login with Origin set to allowed domain -> status 200 but Access-Control-Allow-Origin='*'. Potential mitigation: enforce explicit origin rewrite at final response layer (including ingress/proxy) and block wildcard when credentials are enabled.
